datasets.name: LinkedIn Job Postings 2023–2024 (Kaggle, arshkon/linkedin-job-postings)
datasets.source: Kaggle download; original copies at ./postings.csv and ./archive/
notes: mappings/skills.csv holds 35 coarse LinkedIn job-function categories (e.g. 'Information Technology'), not fine-grained skills; they are stored as job function tags, not as normalized skills.

Byte-identical flat copies of the nested files also exist in Data/raw/linkedin_jobs (benefits.csv, companies.csv, company_industries.csv, company_specialities.csv, employee_counts.csv, industries.csv, job_industries.csv, job_skills.csv, salaries.csv, skills.csv); loaders read only the nested companies/ jobs/ mappings/ layout.
./postings.csv, ./archive/postings.csv and Data/raw/linkedin_jobs/postings.csv are identical (same size and MD5).
datasets.privacy: Public job postings; contains company names and recruiter-written text, no candidate PII.

datasets.name: DataStax LinkedIn Job Listings
datasets.source: Hugging Face (DataStax); original copy at ./clean_jobs.csv with ./gitattributes
notes: Original filename in the workspace was clean_jobs.csv; stored here as postings.csv next to its .gitattributes, separate from the Kaggle postings.csv.
work_type and employment_type columns are entirely/mostly null — see missing statistics.

datasets.name: LinkedIn Job Posts Insights (XLSX)
notes: No job description or URL column: usable for market analytics and dedup cross-reference, not for text retrieval. Excluded from the recommendation index by default.

datasets.name: RemoteOK public job feed (https://remoteok.com/api)
datasets.terms:
API Terms of Service: Please link back (with follow, and without nofollow!) to the URL on Remote OK and mention Remote OK as a source, so we get traffic back from your site. If you do not we'll have to suspend API access.

Please don't use the Remote OK logo without written permission as it's a registered trademark, please DO use our name Remote OK though.
notes: First array element is the API legal notice, not a job.
Some text fields are double-encoded UTF-8 (mojibake); the loader repairs them without altering raw files.
Attribution required: link back to the RemoteOK job URL and mention Remote OK as the source.

datasets.name: Adzuna Jobs API snapshots
notes: Raw API responses saved verbatim per fetch.

datasets.name: Kaggle Resume Dataset (snehaanbhawal/resume-dataset)
datasets.privacy: Resumes are anonymised by the publisher (names/companies replaced), but may still contain quasi-identifiers. Treated as sensitive: never sent to hosted LLMs by default.

datasets.name: resume_corpus (Jiechieu & Tsopze, 2020) — multi-labelled IT resumes

resume_samples.zip.format: id:::occupation labels (';'-separated):::resume text, records separated by '::::::' lines

skills_it.txt.format: Same id:::labels:::text layout as resume_samples.txt (it is a resume subset, not a skill list, despite the filename)

notes: The README calls the archive 'resumes_sample.zip'; the actual file is resume_samples.zip.
The normalized classes file is spelled 'normlized_classes.txt' in the repository.
datasets.privacy: Real resumes scraped from public job boards; contain locations and employer names. Treated as sensitive.

datasets.name: O*NET Database O*NET 31.0 Database August 2026 Release -------------------
notes: Release 31.0 uses new file names: essential_skills.csv and transferable_skills.csv (the former 'Skills' file split), software_skills.csv (former Technology Skills).
software_skills Element IDs identify technology categories; individual tools (Workplace Example) have no O*NET ID, so the project derives stable IDs 'onet-tech:<slug>'.

datasets.name: Open Skills Management Tool (OSMT) — import resources
datasets.source: Workspace ./osmt-develop/ (WGU OSMT source repository). Only import/ CSVs, README and LICENSE were copied; the repository (incl. 1.2 GB UI sources) is preserved in place.
notes: OSMT is application source code (Kotlin/Angular), not a dataset. Its import/ folder contains a BLS SOC hierarchy (BLS-Import.csv), an O*NET occupation list identical in structure to occupation_data.csv, a 2-row example Rich Skill Descriptor file, and a batch-import template.
Used: BLS-Import.csv for SOC major/minor group names; RSD columns inform the Skill node schema.
